name: grav-skeleton-multicourse-hub
description: Open MultiCourse Hub 2 uses a customized version of the Bootstrap4 theme to support a collaborative and version-controlled workflow using Markdown and Git Sync. Includes example multiple course hub content and Admin Panel plugin.

paragraphs: An open, collaborative home for several courses in one site – inside or outside your LMS, with content in portable Markdown files you control.

A free, open-source alternative to Grav Helios Course Hub, built on Grav CMS and the Bootstrap4 Open Matter theme, with Markdown file-based content, a built-in Admin panel, and no database required. Helios Course Hub, built on the premium Helios theme, adds a more refined design, a table of contents on every page, and automatic single or multi-course setup.

A complete, pre-configured package that gives several courses an open and collaborative home in a single site, inside or outside your LMS. Each course has its own pages, header image, sidebar, and footer, and content can also be shared between courses. Content is stored as simple Markdown files you can keep locally, with a built-in Admin panel for browser-based editing and no database required. Runs on nearly any web hosting service.
